# Implement feature

Use `AGENTS.md` and the accepted feature spec. Feature: `${input:feature:Reference a feature or spec}`

- First inspect repository conventions, architecture and existing test/build commands.
- State a compact plan and impacted files.
- Implement a minimal end-to-end slice, preserving boundaries and compatibility.
- Cover invalid input, cancellation/errors and regressions appropriate to feature.
- Run real formatter, linter, tests and build; show commands and results.
- Update docs/ADR if architecture or behavior changes.
- End with **changed files**, **verified**, **not verified**, **risks**. Never fabricate passing results.
